csharpCode: using UnityEngine; public class InspectTraffic { public static string GetTrafficLights() { var tl = GameObject.Find("TrafficLights"); if (tl == null) { var rn = GameObject.Find("Road Network"); if (rn != null) tl = rn.transform.Find("TrafficLights")?.gameObject; } if (tl == null) return "no traffic lights"; var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(); sb.AppendLine("count=" + tl.transform.childCount); int c=0; foreach (Transform t in tl.transform) { if (c>=8) break; sb.AppendLine(t.name + " " + t.position); c++; } return sb.ToString(); } }
